blurb: Guests rent fishing boats, kayaks, canoes, and standup paddleboards to enjoy recreational activities on Mogadore Reservoir. The reservoir offers fishing, boating with electric motors only, kayaking, canoeing, hiking, bird watching, and hunting. The boathouse also sells live bait, fishing tackle, cold drinks, and snacks, and provides a picnic area and fishing pier.
